news.title: Carrick refuses to rule out dropping Fernandes in emotional address
news.description: Manchester United boss Michael Carrick spoke for five minutes and 30 seconds without taking questions at the start of his media briefing to outline what the club means to him, then later refused to rule out dropping captain Bruno Fernandes.

news.title: Arsenal fear Saka could be out for two months
news.description: Arsenal forward Bukayo Saka could be sidelined for up to eight weeks with the quadriceps injury he suffered against Bayern Munich.

news.title: Conte plays down 'unfounded' Man Utd speculation
news.description: Antonio Conte says he is not in advanced talks with any club, in response to speculation he has held talks with Manchester United.

news.title: PSG v Lyon moved as Paris prepares for more protests
news.description: Paris St-Germain's Ligue 1 match against Lyon at the Parc des Princes is pushed back 24 hours as the French capital prepares for another weekend of protests.

news.title: Should Man Utd boss Carrick drop captain Fernandes?
news.description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick must decide whether to leave skipper Bruno Fernandes out of Sunday's crucial Premier League clash with Bournemouth

news.title: What is going on at 'chaotic' Newcastle?
news.description: Will the alarm bells be ringing at Newcastle United if they lose to struggling Crystal Palace on Sunday?

news.title: A Ballon d'Or campaign as fierce off the pitch as on it
news.description: The Ballon d'Or is football's greatest individual accolade - and the thirst to win it has grown in recent years.

news.title: Emery's Villa 2.0 reboot restores optimism before Man City meeting
news.description: Unai Emery's impressive 2.0 reboot has Aston Villa's fans in buoyant mood on the fourth anniversary of his appointment, says chief football writer Phil McNulty.

news.title: Sutton's predictions v Waffle the Wonder Dog and his owner Simon
news.description: BBC Sport football expert Chris Sutton takes on Waffle the Wonder Dog and his owner Simon, plus the BBC readers and AI with his predictions for this weekend's Premier League fixtures.

news.title: Infantino re-election hopes boosted by Asia support
news.description: Gianni Infantino's hopes of being re-elected Fifa president are enhanced by an endorsement from the Asian Football Confederation.
